other_failure_modes.name: Target type conversion failure
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fails to cast a target variable loaded as a categorical or object type into a numeric format (float/int) before passing it to a regression model, causing the script to crash during training.

summary: The agent implements a solid machine learning pipeline with good feature engineering and a robust 10-fold cross-validation strategy across multiple gradient boosting frameworks. However, the solution fails to execute because the target column is read as a categorical type and is never cast to a numeric type before being passed to regressors. Furthermore, it skips explicit data cleaning and relies on arbitrary, untuned weights for ensembling.
